title: 第4章 拉拢人心的方式
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
翌日清晨，刚醒来的陆舟正对着系统面板傻笑……

    【当前云州常住人口数：87万4千6百08人！】

    【今日收益：87万4千6百08两白银！】

    【累计余额：87万9千2百30两白银！】

    新的收益到账了！

    又成富豪了！

    这种感觉确实爽。

    他正准备研究消耗一番，营帐外，忽然传来周川的声音：

    “属下给王爷请安！”

    昨夜袭杀，陆舟原先的营帐被毁，周川便主动将自己的营帐让了出来。

    “进！”陆舟起身，随手整理好衣衫。

    帐帘掀开，周川端着一碗热汤入内，恭敬行礼：“王爷，这是您的早膳。”

    说罢，他又取出两个大饼递了过来，神色略显局促尴尬。

    陆舟目光微凝，心中了然。

    野外荒凉，但他们好歹是从京城过来的，何至于如此寒酸？

    不用想，定是刘傲暗中刻意刁难。

    眼前这早膳，多半是周川自己的口粮。

    “有劳周副将了。”他顺势接过。

    武者每日的消耗极大，更何况自己还受伤了，更需补充体力。

    “王爷，您的伤好点了吗？属下这还剩了点金疮药。”周川又忙不迭地从怀中拿出自己珍藏的小瓷瓶。

    他听闻眼前这位王爷武道资质平庸，身娇体弱，担心路上再有闪失。

    一旦对方出事，他们底下护送的人，第一个就要遭殃。

    “有心了，不过本王好得差不多了。”陆舟没有收下。

    此人倒是心细。

    恰好他存着让其护卫自己的打算，于是乎心念一动，从系统空间直接拿出了一张一千两的银票。

    “倒是昨夜，多亏了周副将，这算本王一点心意。”他放下热汤，将银票递了过去。

    笼络人心，钱财向来是最稳妥的法子！

    不过陆舟并没有盲目拿出大量钱财。

    一来，财不露白。

    他尚未摸清周川心性，骤然重金相送，一旦勾起对方贪念，反倒容易招来祸端。

    其次，经过此前相处，他看得出周川是一个谨小慎微之人。

    这种人，骤然面对天大好处，只会心生忌惮，下意识推辞，生怕背后藏着莫测风险。

    所以陆舟决定先施以小恩小惠，拉近双方关系，等时机成熟，再驱使对方去做一些其他事。

    而周川在看到那张一千两的银票后，愣了一下。

    紧接着连忙拒绝：“保护王爷是属下之责，岂能收下如此贵重之物！”

    一千两！

    对于一年俸禄不过一百多两的周川而言，无异于天降横财！

    说不心动，那是假的。

    但他却不敢收。

    不仅仅是因为陆舟身份敏感，更担心若被刘傲知晓，自己肯定吃不了兜着走。

    “区区千两，比起救命之恩，算不了什么。本王虽然被废，但底蕴还在，周副将何须客气？”陆舟却直接将其塞到对方怀中，大方十足！
content_en:
The next morning, Lu Zhou, who had just woken up, was smiling stupidly at the system panel...

    [The current permanent population of Yunzhou: 874,608 people! 】

    [Today’s income: 874,608 taels of silver! 】

    [Cumulative balance: 879,230 taels of silver! 】

    New income has arrived!

    Become a rich man again!

    It feels really good.

    He was about to study and spend some time when Zhou Chuan's voice suddenly came from outside the camp:

    "My subordinates, please pay your respects to the prince!"

    During the attack last night, Lu Zhou's original tent was destroyed, so Zhou Chuan took the initiative to give up his tent.

    "Come in!" Lu Zhou stood up and straightened his clothes.

    The curtain was opened, and Zhou Chuan entered with a bowl of hot soup and saluted respectfully: "Your Majesty, this is your breakfast."

    After that, he took out two more large cakes and handed them over, looking slightly embarrassed.

    Lu Zhou's eyes narrowed slightly, understanding in his heart.

    The wilderness is desolate, but after all they came from the capital, why are they so shabby?

    No need to think about it, Liu Ao must be secretly deliberately making things difficult.

    The breakfast in front of him was mostly Zhou Chuan's own rations.

    "Thank you, Vice Admiral Zhou." He took it.

    The daily consumption of a warrior is huge, not to mention that he is injured and needs to replenish his physical strength.

    "Your Majesty, is your injury feeling better? I still have some medicine left." Zhou Chuan hurriedly took out the small porcelain bottle he had collected from his arms.

    He heard that the prince in front of him had mediocre martial arts qualifications and was delicate and frail, so he was worried that something might happen to him on the way.

    Once something happens to the other party, the people they are escorting will be the first to suffer.

    "I'm interested, but I'm pretty good." Lu Zhou didn't accept it.

    This person is quite attentive.

    It just so happened that he had the intention of letting him protect him, so with a thought, he took out a thousand tael silver note directly from the system space.

    "Last night, thanks to Vice Admiral Zhou, this is my kindness." He put down the hot soup and handed over the banknote.

    Money is always the safest way to win over people's hearts!

    However, Lu Zhou did not spend a large amount of money blindly.

    Once it comes, wealth will not be revealed in vain.

    He hadn't figured out Zhou Chuan's character yet, so he suddenly sent him a huge sum of money. Once he aroused the other party's greed, it would easily lead to disaster.

    Secondly, after getting along before, he could see that Zhou Chuan was a cautious person.

    This kind of person, when suddenly faced with a huge benefit, will only feel wary and subconsciously refuse, for fear that there are unpredictable risks hidden behind it.

    So Lu Zhou decided to offer small favors first to bring the two parties closer, and then when the time was right, he would force the other party to do other things.

    Zhou Chuan was stunned for a moment after seeing the one thousand tael silver note.

    Then he quickly refused: "It is my duty to protect the prince, how can I accept such a valuable thing!"

    One thousand taels!

    For Zhou Chuan, whose annual salary is only more than one hundred taels, this is tantamount to a windfall from heaven!

    It would be a lie to say that I am not moved.

    But he didn't dare to accept it.

    Not only was Lu Zhou's identity sensitive, he was also worried that if Liu Ao found out, he would definitely not be able to take advantage of him.

    "It's just a thousand taels, but it's nothing compared to the grace of saving a life. Although I have been deposed, my heritage is still there, so why should Vice General Zhou be polite?" Lu Zhou directly stuffed him into the other party's arms, so generous!
title_en: Chapter 4 Ways to Win People’s Hearts
